english.title: Publish in course of business a tobacco advert in a newspaper / periodical / other publication
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[proprietor]_
(B)_[editor]_

of a newspaper, periodical or other publication, namely **(..SPECIFY PUBLICATION..), which contained a tobacco advertisement, namely **(..SPECIFY ADVERTISEMENT..), in the course of a business published in the United Kingdom
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 3(a) and 16(2) of the Tobacco Advertising and Promotion Act 2002.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
NoneNote
Note that for offences committed since 12 March 2015, section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 removes the limits on certain fines given by the Magistrates' Courts. Offences that were previously punishable by fines of 'prescribed sums' and that were limited to 'not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale' or 'not exceeding the statutory maximum', are now punishable by a fine of any amount.
